invariants.name: draw_calls_observed_on_encode
invariants.note: A painted UI+shader-node frame must issue at least one real draw. Missing stays not-evaluable.

invariants.name: gpu_upload_bytes_observed_on_encode
invariants.note: Count only after a host encodes/submits. Missing stays not-evaluable and must never be treated as 0.

notes: NanaUI-internal GPU scale row; not Issue #8 DoD and has no Iced/GPUI analog. 256 GpuView nodes sharing one slot_id, interleaved with ordinary UI. Measures per-node draw/bind/upload cost with the frame-graph resource count held at one. Ratchets on batch_rebuilds, gpu_buffer_reallocations and draw_batches land with the commits that make them pass.
